item.title: The Chow Kit market is crowded, shoppers flock to prepare for the end of Ramadan
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The atmosphere at Chow Kit Market today was lively with the presence of people making final preparations ahead of the arrival of Ramadan, with most traders reporting an increase in customers since early morning. item.title: Thousands attend state-level Chinese New Year celebration in Sabah
item.description: KOTA KINABALU (Feb 18): Thousands of visitors of various races thronged the state-level 2026 Chinese New Year Open House at the Sabah International Convention Centre (SICC) here today, reflecting the state’s enduring spirit of unity and harmony. Yang Dipertua Negeri Tun Musa Aman and his wife, Toh Puan Faridah Tussin, arrived at 11 am and were received by Chief Minister Datuk Seri Hajiji Noor and his wife, Datin Seri Juliah Salag.
